integrity.finite_check_scope: 18 instruction sequences and 216 source/target length pairs; finite checks are not the proof

scientific_limitations: Transfer is between a word and its shifted-instruction decimation; same-word identity holds for shift-fixed instructions.
Length must be divisible by four and at least eight.
The general base-length cyclic complexity is not solved.
Historical priority remains qualified by incomplete access to the 1994 canonical-position paper.
title: Two-to-one cyclic-class lifting in generalized paperfolding words
